title: Nautilus SMP
description: A whitelisted vanilla+ server focused on playing modern minecraft with some immersive visual features and nicer terrain
body:
## 📖 About
Nautilus SMP is a whitelisted Minecraft SMP aimed towards playing the latest Minecraft version with a custom modpack consisting of vanilla style terrain generation mods and visual enhancements. 

## ⚪ Whitelist
The server is **currently invite only** but whitelist applications will be added shortly!
